changelog:
- Modern Audio Brief Mini-Player: Sentence-chunked TTS engine with instant Play, Pause, Resume, Stop, live progress bar, playback speed (0.85x to 1.5x), voice toggle, and crisp soundwave icon.
- Seamless Ask AI Session Persistence: Tapping any source link keeps your active Ask AI thread alive with a one-tap Resume banner on source tabs and automatic chat restoration when returning.
- X & Instagram Viewport-Focal Extraction: Locked Fokk AI onto the exact visible post on virtualized feeds (fixing Instagram's 2-posts-above bug) and fixed X post lead images to show real tweet media instead of generic placeholders.
- Truth & Bias Pro Upgrades: Added Visual Context & Entities photography gallery, Political/Tone Bias Spectrum indicator, Sensationalism meter, Fact/Claim/Opinion ratio bar, and The Other Side counter-perspective.
- Summary Reading Depth Switcher: Switch any summary between Brief, ELI5 (plain English), and Deep analytical depth.
